title: Give Quick Access the same transition as the System Shell

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment found no remaining actionable defect in the current change. The previously accepted issues are addressed in the current source; repeated locking concerns and dependency/logging preferences did not establish a reachable failure or a design mismatch.

**Validation scope:** Nine existing state/parser tests passed using the unchanged source in an isolated test project. This does not certify the production WinUI/XAML build, shell-animation callbacks, multi-monitor/mixed-DPI placement, or focus-loss behavior.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified review summary, not an unconditional approval.

actions.label: Post qualified assessment summary (no code changes requested)
